clue.text: Bit of 'elp given to comparatively unskilled burglar?

parts.note: a hint is a bit of help; with the H dropped, as in 'elp, it becomes 'INT
ruder means more crude or primitive, less skilled

explanation.surface: A clumsy burglar is getting a little Cockney assistance.
explanation.walkthrough: The dropped H of 'elp tells you to drop the H from the synonym too.
explanation.definitionFit: A burglar is one kind of unwelcome person who breaks in, hence the question mark marking an example.

clue.text: 5 across recording goes around with a 17

indicators.note: the recording piece encloses the other piece, as a wrapper goes around something

parts.note: CD, a compact disc, is a recording
5 across is SINGLE, which here gives its synonym LONE

explanation.surface: A record release spins round, paired with its counterpart.
explanation.walkthrough: 17 is DOUBLE: a clone is an exact copy, so something cloned comes with a double.
explanation.definitionFit: Something copied exactly has a duplicate, an identical twin alongside it.

clue.text: Fancy date with hot-headed guy? It may look harmless

indicators.note: fancy as an adjective means elaborate, so the letters are rearranged
the H (hot) is moved to the head of the word

parts.note: a guy is a chap

explanation.surface: A fussy dinner date with a quick-tempered man may seem innocent enough.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fancy' rearranges DATE to DEAT; 'hot-headed' moves the H of CHAP to the front, giving HCAP.
explanation.definitionFit: The death cap is a deadly toadstool that looks like an ordinary edible mushroom.

clue.text: 17 7 is an exhibition of 5 acrosses or 17s but not 16s

definitions.text: an exhibition of 5 acrosses or 17s but not 16s

parts.note: 17 down is DOUBLE; ten is the first double-figure value
7 down gives its usual one-letter abbreviation N
taken as written

explanation.surface: A cross-referenced puzzle line about a show featuring ones and twos but no threes.
explanation.walkthrough: Singles and doubles are tennis matches, but there are no triples. The cross-references are 5 across SINGLE, 17 DOUBLE, 16 TRIPLE.
explanation.definitionFit: A tennis match may be played as singles or doubles, never as a three-a-side game.

clue.text: One half of 9

definitions.meaning: 9 across is DRY RUN; its second half, RUN

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a run scored off one hit is a single.
explanation.definitionFit: One is a solitary item, and one cricket run is also known by this term.

clue.text: ID for one "Holby City" anaesthetic?

parts.note: Holby City was a long-running BBC hospital drama, an example of a television serial
something that numbs, read whimsically as one more numb

explanation.surface: Identification needed for a painkiller in a TV hospital drama.
explanation.walkthrough: Holby City is a British TV hospital drama. Its medical setting fits the false anaesthetic reading.
explanation.definitionFit: A unique code stamped on an item serves as its identification.

clue.text: Reading, say, in 5 across 7, a long runner?

indicators.note: the letter is placed inside the other piece

parts.note: 5 across and 7 together make a single digit, of which seven is one
reading is one of the three Rs, so it gives R

explanation.surface: The Berkshire town of Reading is cast as a lengthy runner.
explanation.walkthrough: Reading is a Berkshire town on the Thames, not this river, which is the misdirection. A river runs, and this one is Britain's longest.
explanation.definitionFit: A river is something that runs, and this is the longest river in Britain.

clue.text: See 5
Prone to go out for some time, North Pole gets hammered in appropriately?

definitions.text: Prone to go out for some time

indicators.note: the scrambled letters go inside the other piece

parts.note: arctic is the fitting region for the North Pole

indicators.note: hammered means battered out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A drunken North Pole explorer keeps passing out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'North Pole' does double duty: it gives N and the anagram fodder, and it is why the Arctic is 'appropriately' the container. 'gets hammered' scrambles; 'in' places those letters inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Narcolepsy makes a person fall asleep suddenly, so a sufferer is prone to drop off.

clue.text: TT Race practice

parts.note: TT means teetotal, which is dry
to run is to race

explanation.surface: Practice laps before the Isle of Man TT motorcycle race.
explanation.walkthrough: The Isle of Man TT is a famous motorcycle race, but here TT is teetotal.
explanation.definitionFit: A rehearsal before the real event is a trial with nothing at stake.

clue.text: Manny R's friend gets stuck into some opposition

indicators.note: the friend is pushed inside the other word

parts.note: any means some
Manny Ribera's friend in the film Scarface is Tony Montana, Tony M

explanation.surface: A gangster's pal wades into a fight with rivals.
explanation.walkthrough: Manny Ribera and Tony Montana are characters in Scarface.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the relation of words with opposite meanings, an opposition of sense.

clue.text: Pass some bananas

definitions.meaning: to pass something to someone is to give it over
a bunch of bananas is called by this name, like fingers on a palm

explanation.definitionFit: To pass is to give over by hand; a cluster of bananas on the stem is also known by this word.

clue.text: Franglais patients contact policemen about bird

indicators.note: about means turned around, so the pieces are read backwards

parts.note: French les with English sick: a mixture of the two languages
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department of the British police

explanation.surface: Patients speaking mangled French get in touch with officers about a bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns LESSICKCID round to give the whole answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The dickcissel is a small North American songbird.

clue.text: 21 11 is badly 8

indicators.note: badly means in a mangled way, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: 8 down is the source of these letters

explanation.surface: A cross-referenced line about poor something.
explanation.walkthrough: 21 11 is SLOW HAND, the guitarist's nickname.
explanation.definitionFit: The blues guitarist was nicknamed Slowhand, which is also the title of his 1977 album.

clue.text: 7 of these pieces make 17 16

parts.note: the number of pieces on the board at the start is twice sixteen, thirty-two

explanation.walkthrough: There are 32 pieces at the start of a game, double sixteen.
explanation.definitionFit: Board-game pieces in the game of kings and queens total thirty-two at the start.

clue.text: New edition of book locates reason for lack of progress

indicators.note: a new edition reworks the material, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A revised book finds why things have stalled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New edition of' scrambles B plus LOCATES.
explanation.definitionFit: A hindrance or barrier is what stops progress.

clue.text: Bet made by 5 across and 17 down?

explanation.definitionFit: A wager on three outcomes combined; also one plus two makes threefold.

clue.text: Repeated consumption of 5 across (or 16!) might make you see it

definitions.text: Repeated consumption of 5 across (or 16!) might make you see it

parts.words: Repeated consumption of 5 across (or 16!) might make you see it
parts.note: drinking one measure after another blurs your vision so you see two of everything

explanation.walkthrough: 5 across is SINGLE and 16 is TRIPLE, both measures of spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: Heavy drinking blurs the eyesight so that things appear twofold.

clue.text: He keeps complaining about energy-filled Mr Active's death

indicators.note: the complainer goes around the rest

parts.note: someone who keeps complaining is a griper

indicators.note: energy fills the gentleman, so it goes inside

parts.note: Mr is written as MR and active abbreviates to A
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A grumbler moans about the demise of an energetic man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'He keeps complaining' looks like the definition but describes a griper; 'filled' puts energy inside Mr A, and 'about' wraps the complainer round that. Death is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The cloaked figure with a scythe personifies death.

clue.text: Better qualified as someone to provide a welcome

definitions.meaning: meet means fitting or suitable, so this is more suitable

explanation.definitionFit: Meet is an old word for suitable, giving its comparative; and a greeter meets people.

clue.text: Fame thus far executed by name

indicators.note: executed means beheaded, so the first letter is lost

parts.note: ere now means before now, thus far

explanation.surface: Someone becomes famous after an execution under their own name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'executed' beheads ERENOW, giving RENOW.
explanation.definitionFit: Renown is widespread celebrity and acclaim.

clue.text: Delay delivery of gin?

indicators.note: the spoken delivery of a word, how it is said

parts.note: sloe gin is flavoured with sloes, the blackthorn fruit

explanation.surface: Late arrival of a bottle of gin.
explanation.walkthrough: Sloe gin is a British liqueur made by steeping blackthorn fruit in gin.
explanation.definitionFit: To delay is to hold back or make later.

clue.text: Evening do, one at which reporters meet Brynner and McKenna together, say

parts.note: a means one
the press are reporters
Yul Brynner and Virginia McKenna starred together in The King and I, abbreviated KI

explanation.surface: A party where journalists meet two stage stars together.
explanation.walkthrough: The King and I is abbreviated KI.
explanation.definitionFit: Après-ski is the socialising in the evening after a day on the slopes.

clue.text: Barney Rubble, perhaps, close at 11

indicators.note: rubble is broken fragments, so the letters are scattered

explanation.surface: The cartoon character Barney Rubble lives just next door.
explanation.walkthrough: Barney Rubble is a Flintstones character; 'Rubble' is the anagram signal. 11 across is HAND, so close at hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Close at hand means only a short distance away.

clue.text: Legs that with 17 7 could make 13, the same as …

definitions.text: Legs that with 17 7 could make 13, the same as …

parts.words: Legs that with 17 7 could make 13, the same as …
parts.note: a bingo call is legs, and that figure plus two has the same letters as the next answer plus one, an anagram like 13 of 8

explanation.walkthrough: Legs eleven is a bingo call. ELEVEN PLUS TWO is an anagram of TWELVE PLUS ONE, as 13 is of 8; 17 7 is a double number, two.
explanation.definitionFit: In bingo the number called as legs is this one, and its anagram partnership with the next clue is famous.

clue.text: … apostles with 5 across 7

parts.note: the count of apostles, which with a single unit added matches the previous clue's letters

explanation.walkthrough: There were twelve apostles; twelve plus one is an anagram of the previous answer plus two.
explanation.definitionFit: Jesus chose this many apostles, the number of disciples in the Gospels.
